A collection of links I find useful or often recommend.

## For undergraduates

### Learning mathematics

- [3Blue1Brown](https://www.youtube.com/@3blue1brown): visual explanations of
  mathematics, including a series on linear algebra
- [Keith Conrad's expository papers](https://kconrad.math.uconn.edu/blurbs/): clear,
  self-contained notes on algebra and number theory
- [Terence Tao's career advice](https://terrytao.wordpress.com/career-advice/): essays on
  studying and working in mathematics
- [*Book of Proof*](https://richardhammack.github.io/BookOfProof/) by Richard Hammack,
  [*Linear Algebra Done Right*](https://linear.axler.net) by Sheldon Axler, and
  [*Linear Algebra Done Wrong*](https://www.math.brown.edu/streil/papers/LADW/LADW.html)
  by Sergei Treil, all free online
- [Springer textbooks](https://link.springer.com): many can be downloaded free through
  [MSU Libraries](https://lib.msu.edu); sign in with your MSU NetID

### Research and summer programs

- [NSF Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU)](https://new.nsf.gov/funding/opportunities/research-experiences-undergraduates-reu):
  paid summer research programs
- [MathPrograms.org](https://www.mathprograms.org): applications for many REUs and
  graduate programs
- [MSU Summer Topology Program](https://sites.google.com/msu.edu/msutopologyrtg/activities/summer-topology-program-2026): a summer program in topology for
  undergraduates
- [Budapest Semesters in Mathematics](https://www.budapestsemesters.com): a semester of
  mathematics abroad

### At MSU

- [MSU Mathematics undergraduate program](https://math.msu.edu/undergraduate)
- [Mathematics Learning Center](https://math.msu.edu/mlc): free drop-in tutoring for
  MTH courses
- [MSU Food Bank](https://foodbank.msu.edu)
- [Counseling and Psychiatric Services (CAPS)](https://caps.msu.edu)
- [Resource Center for Persons with Disabilities (RCPD)](https://rcpd.msu.edu)

## Getting around East Lansing

- [CATA](https://www.cata.org): buses around campus, East Lansing, and Lansing
- [Michigan Flyer](https://www.michiganflyer.com): coach service between East Lansing,
  Ann Arbor, and Detroit Metro Airport (DTW)
- [Amtrak](https://www.amtrak.com/home): trains from East Lansing to Chicago
- [Capital Region International Airport (LAN)](https://www.flylansing.com): the local
  airport in Lansing
- [MSU Bikes](https://bikes.msu.edu): bike rentals, repairs, and parts on campus
- [MSU campus map](https://maps.msu.edu)
- [East Lansing Public Library](https://www.elpl.org)
